changes.title: Reconstructed Questions FAQ Tooltip Mobile Width & Small Screen Max-Width Optimization
changes.description: Resolved right screen border clipping and website width distortion from the reconstructed questions FAQ tooltip (.faq-tooltip-content). Enforced box-sizing: border-box, capped modal max-width at 90% of screen width for mobile displays (centered with 5% side margins), and enabled 100% full-screen width adaptation for very small screens (<= 480px).

changes.title: Tooltip Content Hover Persistence & Unclipped Bridge Optimization
changes.description: Resolved premature tooltip hiding when moving cursor over the scrollable text: added an unclipped container hover bridge preventing hover loss across the vertical gap, ensured persistent visibility while hovering the card (.is-hovered), and set a comfortable 0.6s grace period.

changes.title: Mobile Tooltip Screen-Centered Alignment & Dynamic Arrow Positioning
changes.description: Engineered dynamic viewport centering for the reconstructed questions FAQ tooltip on mobile devices, keeping the modal centered across the screen with responsive margins while dynamically positioning the upward-pointing arrow directly below the tooltip button.

changes.title: Wider Tooltip Modal Width, Faster Unhover & Instant Outside-Click Dismissal
changes.description: Expanded the reconstructed questions FAQ tooltip on mobile to full screen width (calc(100vw - 36px)) with desktop max-width of 700px. Accelerated unhover hiding delay to 0.25s, and added instant dismissal when clicking or tapping outside.

changes.title: Extended FAQ Tooltip Hiding Delay to 2 Seconds
changes.description: Increased the unhover grace period on the reconstructed questions FAQ tooltip in the Donate section (.faq-tooltip-content) from 1 second to 2 seconds across desktop and mobile screens, giving users ample time to read and interact with the content.

changes.title: Enhanced Intermittent Horizontal Shake for Reconstructed Questions Heading
changes.description: Enhanced the intermittent horizontal shake animation on 'Faculty took the questions away?' in the Donate section: increased oscillation amplitude to ±8px with smooth damping, removed the block-level heading hover-pause constraint that was freezing the animation, and optimized the cycle to 3.8s for crisp, noticeable visibility.

changes.title: Donate Section FAQ Tooltip Grace Period & Hover Bridge
changes.description: Enhanced the reconstructed questions FAQ tooltip in the Donate section (.faq-tooltip-container) to stay open for 1 full second after cursor is unhovered before smoothly fading out. Added an invisible bridge pseudo-element between the icon and tooltip content preventing accidental hover dropouts, and implemented tap-to-toggle support on mobile and desktop.

changes.title: First-Visit Contribution Incentive Modal for QBank & Donate
changes.description: Added a responsive introductory modal shown the first time visitors navigate to either the Question Bank (#Qbank) or Donate Resources (#Donate) section. Features bilingual motivational copy explaining the reciprocal donation cycle of questions and notes, Islamic benediction, localStorage first-visit tracking, dark/light theme support, and dedicated manual trigger buttons.

changes.title: Desktop Home Button Restoration & Search Courses Removal
changes.description: Restored the desktop floating Home button (#spa-back-btn) aligned with the top frosted-glass header, allowing instant one-click return to the home view. Removed the redundant Search Courses button from the top navigation bar across all content sections, keeping only direct departmental and resource section links.

changes.title: Expanded Top Navigation Bar Buttons for Content Sections
changes.description: Updated the desktop top navigation bar across all content sections to include all 8 primary navigation buttons (Search Courses, Info, Question Bank, Departments, Donate, ECA, Library, About) matching the main navigation list. Added flex wrapping and proportional button padding to ensure seamless rendering across all desktop screen sizes.

changes.title: Desktop Top Navigation Bar for Content Sections
changes.description: Added persistent desktop top navigation bar (Home, Departments, Q-Bank, Library) to all content-section views in index.html matching the Departments.html header aesthetics. Features frosted-glass backdrop filter, centered links, and seamless SPA routing without page reloads, while suppressing the navigation on mobile to preserve touch drawer ergonomics.

changes.title: Desktop Screen Size CSS Restoration & Media Query Scoping
changes.description: Resolved critical styling failure on desktop screens caused by an unclosed @media (max-width: 768px) block in style.css. The missing closing brace after #theme-toggle inadvertently trapped over 4,500 lines of core styling (including html layout, universal custom matte scrollbars, body flex centering, typography, and desktop components) inside the mobile-only query, causing browsers to ignore desktop styles entirely.

changes.title: Mobile Scheduler Nav Drawer Item (above Coffee button)
changes.description: Revised mobile b1t Scheduler approach: hides fixed #floating-button entirely on mobile and adds a .mobile-scheduler-nav-item list item inside the sliding nav drawer directly above the Coffee support button. Styled as a pill button with float animation matching the drawer aesthetic. Removed IntersectionObserver script and pendulum hanging animation — no longer needed on mobile.

changes.title: Pendulum Hanging Animation for Mobile Scheduler Button
changes.description: Redesigned the mobile hanging b1t Scheduler droplet button animation: changed transform-origin from 0 50% (left-center, causing windshield-wiper motion) to 50% 0 (top-center suspension point), positioned directly below #theme-toggle at right: 10px; top: 55px. Keyframes now swing cleanly from rotate(-8deg) through 0deg to rotate(8deg) like a true pendulum. Removed conflicting transform transition from desktop #floating-button CSS. Simplified IntersectionObserver to initialize hidden and toggle opacity only via inline style.

changes.title: Mobile Drawer Coffee Button Placement & IntersectionObserver Scheduler Transition
changes.description: Moved the mobile navigation drawer Coffee support button downward directly above the Changelog trigger, eliminating top-drawer fixed coordinates. Implemented IntersectionObserver visibility detection on the intro section with cubic-bezier spring transitions for the hanging scheduler droplet button on mobile viewports, modeled after portfolio reference patterns.

changes.title: Upload Section Mobile Button Padding & Scaling
changes.description: Scaled down button padding and dimensions for .upload-card across mobile screen widths (padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem and 135px width/height on <=768px, padding: 0.5rem and 120px width/height on <=480px) with proportional grid gap tuning, matching the scaled-down card images and ensuring snug, well-proportioned button footprints.

changes.title: Question Bank Modal Mobile Width Stabilization & Truncation
changes.description: Resolved mobile width stretching in the Question Bank modal when displaying long file names. Enforced strict flex and block-level text ellipsis on .qbank-link and .explorer-item-name with min-width: 0 and overflow-x: hidden containment across all modal container levels, locking mobile modal width invariant to content.

changes.title: Hanging Water Droplet Scheduler & Mobile Sidebar Coffee Button
changes.description: Redesigned the mobile b1t Scheduler button as an elongated water droplet suspended 90 degrees downward beneath the theme toggle with fluid pendulum swaying micro-animation and tapered asymmetric padding. Relocated the Coffee support button directly into the mobile navigation drawer in place of the previous scheduler link.

changes.title: Mobile Floating Buttons Placement Swap
changes.description: Swapped mobile screen placement between the Coffee support button (#support-qr-persistent) and the b1t Scheduler button (#floating-button). On mobile screens (<=768px), b1t Scheduler now sits prominently in the top header beside the theme toggle while the persistent Coffee button is concealed.

changes.title: Upload Section Mobile Card Image Scaling
changes.description: Scaled down .upload-card-image dimensions on mobile screen widths (from 150px to 105px on <=768px and 90px on <=480px) with proportionally tuned margins, preventing card overcrowding and enhancing visual proportioning.

changes.title: Persistent Support Button & Mobile Navigation Overlap Prevention
changes.description: Resolved overlap between the persistent Coffee support button (#support-qr-persistent) and the mobile navigation drawer (#sticky-nav). Lowered button z-index to 2500, elevated mobile drawer and overlay z-indices to 3500/3400, and added automatic fade-out dismissal whenever the drawer is open.

changes.title: Mobile Navigation Drawer Centering & Floating Button Margin
changes.description: Added responsive top margin (8.5rem) to the mobile navigation links list (.sticky-nav ul) to cleanly center the navigation items in the sidebar drawer and completely prevent overlap with the floating b1t Scheduler button.

changes.title: Unclosed Parent Modal Hierarchy Resolution
changes.description: Resolved critical HTML nesting issue where #changelog-modal was trapped inside an unclosed hidden #qbank-modal container, preventing the changelog modal from rendering on screen.

changes.title: Mobile Navigation Drawer Changelog Button Relocation
changes.description: Moved the mobile Changelog button to the very bottom of the sliding navigation drawer with an automatic top margin anchor and subtle border separator for a cleaner menu layout.

changes.title: Changelog Modal Offline & Protocol Resiliency
changes.description: Resolved issue where the changelog modal would not display upon button click due to CORS fetch restrictions on file:// protocols. Added embedded fallback data, delegated document click listeners, inline onclick fallbacks, and elevated overlay z-index.

changes.title: Changelog Manual Trigger Buttons (Desktop & Mobile)
changes.description: Added responsive trigger buttons to manually open the What's New changelog modal: a floating glassmorphic pill button positioned at the bottom-left of the homepage for desktop, and a dedicated menu item with a live version badge inside the mobile navigation drawer.

changes.title: Search Bar Clear Button
changes.description: Added an interactive clear button (X) inside the course search input that dynamically appears when typing, allowing one-click query clearance and refocusing with dark and light theme support.

changes.title: Visitor Changelog Modal & Changes JSON Architecture
changes.description: Implemented an automated 'What's New' visitor changelog modal modeled on b1t-Sched, automatically detecting new site updates based on Service Worker CACHE_NAME, with full dark/light theme support, tag pills, and an accordion for earlier releases.

changes.title: Course Search Enter Selection & Dual-Theme Keyboard Navigation
changes.description: Allowed desktop users to press Enter in the course search input to immediately open the top result in a new tab without prior arrow navigation. Replaced hardcoded inline colors with semantic .active classes and high-contrast dual-theme highlight styles.

changes.title: Dark Theme Contrast for Mirror Links & Sitewide .link-hover-a
changes.description: Resolved low contrast issue in the bottom mirror links banner ([mirror: Netlify / GitHub]). Replaced hardcoded black text in .link-hover-a with bright accent color #64b5f6 in dark theme and #1976d2 in light theme sitewide.

changes.title: Submission Page Mobile Floating Back Button
changes.description: Repositioned the back button on mobile devices (<= 768px) to float at the bottom-right corner with a pill shape, glassmorphic backdrop blur, and dark-theme border glow, matching the mobile home button on index.html.

changes.title: Animated Collapsible Notice Banner with Top-Bar Info Trigger
changes.description: Implemented dynamic notice banner architecture that displays prominently on initial page load, then automatically glides and minimizes into a top-bar info trigger icon after 4 seconds (with hover-pause). Clicking the icon expands or collapses the banner with smooth animation.

changes.title: Compact Circular Icon Actions on Mobile Submissions
changes.description: Hid text labels on mobile screen widths, transforming the notification action buttons into compact 44x44px circular icon buttons with tooltips and accessible touch hit zones.

changes.title: Club Resources Sub-Section & Wings Modal Architecture
changes.description: Added a dedicated Club Resources sub-section inside Extra Curricular Activities (ECA) with interactive department club badges and popup modal displaying parent Google Drive access and subsidiary focus wings across all 10 academic departments.

changes.title: QBank Full-Screen Popup Modal
changes.description: Replaced the inline dropdown accordion with a centered launcher button opening a 96vw x 92vh full-screen dialog with circular protruding close button, header banner, tap-outside dismiss, and Escape key handling.

changes.title: Mobile Floating Home Button & Dark Theme Contrast
changes.description: Repositioned #spa-back-btn on mobile viewports to the bottom-right corner (bottom: 2rem; right: 1.5rem;) with pure white text and icon on hover in dark theme.

changes.title: 100vh Viewport Scroll Optimization & Section Headroom Restoration
changes.description: Eliminated unnecessary scrolling to blank trailing space when sections fit within 100vh, while preserving generous top clearance below top floating overlays.

changes.title: Universal Matte Scrollbars & Sticky Nav Width Stabilization
changes.description: Deployed custom matte scrollbars across the website and modals, and stabilized layout width during sidebar expansion using scrollbar-gutter: stable.

changes.title: Light Theme (Gray Mode) Comprehensive Contrast Audit
changes.description: Un-nested global gray theme styles to cover mobile viewports and eliminated hardcoded inline white styles across headings, paragraphs, hints, tooltips, tables, and file explorer cards.

changes.title: Visitor Counter & Glitch Intro Archival to old-code/
changes.description: Cleaned up the production homepage by excising the delayed visitor counter badge and first-visit chromatic aberration glitch intro, preserving both as standalone modular test benches in old-code/.

changes.title: Legacy Codebase & Old Design Architectural Archive
changes.description: Created comprehensive documentation in doc/old-files-archive.md analyzing legacy UI patterns, mobile drawer FAB controllers, preloaders, and semester selectors.

changes.title: Agent Guidelines & Archiving Workflow Synchronization
changes.description: Standardized AI development workflows in AGENTS.md, automated history tracking in doc/history.md, and established full turn prompt archiving in doc/prompts/.
